items.title: Percy Gabriel Interview, 1987-07-10
items.q: I remember Albert Fernandes. He would... When Clarence took a break, he'd jump on the piano... Albert would play trumpet.

ctx.x: There was a Cat Man. Cat Man? Yeah, Robert Catman. That was Cat Man.
Yeah, he and there was, little Al was out with him playing bass. Al? Yeah.
Brown skin fella? Yeah, little thin fella.
